title: Records
explain: A record is a short way to declare an immutable data class. The compiler generates the constructor, accessors, `equals`, `hashCode` and `toString` from the component list. You can add validation in a compact constructor and extra methods in the body.
exercise: Define a `Person` record with a name and an age, and reject negative ages in the compact constructor.
tip: Record fields are final, so you can't set them later. To change a value, create a new record with the updated component.
